sa: क्व गमिष्यथ भद्रं वस्त्यक्तवास्मान् दुःखभागिनः। वयमप्यनुयास्यामो यत्र यूयं गमिष्यथ॥
en: The citizens said : Be blessed. Where will you go leaving us (behind) who are in great grief? We shall go where you will go.

sa: एवं विचार्य बहुशो वार्ष्णेयः पर्यचिन्तयत्। हृदयेन महाराज पुण्यश्लोकस्य सारथिः॥
en: O the foremost of kings, having deliberated upon this over and over again, Varshneya, the charioteer of virtuous Nala, went on thinking in his mind.

sa: नान्यद् दुःखतरं किञ्चिल्लोकेषु प्रतिभाति मे अथैविहीनः पुरुषः परैः सम्परिभूयते॥
en: I believe there is no more pitiable sight in the world than that of men destitute of wealth being insulted by others (who possess wealth).

sa: ततः शक्रो महातेजास्तं दिदृक्षुरुपागमत्। ततो देवा महेन्द्रं तमपृच्छन्धास्यतीति किम्॥
en: Then greatly effulgent, Indra came there with the desire of seeing him. Thereupon the celestials asked Indra, “What is to be sucked by this boy?"

sa: स तु गच्छन्ननेकाग्रः सभामेकोऽन्वचिन्तयत्। श्रियं च तामनुपमां धर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: In proceeding (towards his city) with an afflicted heart, he only reflected on the matchless Assembly-hall and the great prosperity of the intelligent Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira).

sa: कथं च द्वादश समा वने तेषां महामुने। व्यतीयुर्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ शूराणामरिघातिनाम्॥
en: O great Rishi, O best of the Brahmanas, how did the twelve years of those heroes, those slayers of foes, pass away in the forest?

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महासेनं निवृत्तः सह दैवतैः। अनुज्ञातो भगवता त्र्यम्बकेण शचीपतिः॥
en: Having said this to Mahasena, the husband of Sachi with the permission of the three eyed deity (Shiva) left the place accompanied by the celestials.

sa: एवमुक्तास्त्वगच्छंस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वतो दिशम्। ते पुराणि नलं मृगयितुं राजंस्तदा व्यसनिनं तथा॥ सराष्ट्राणि ग्रामान् घोषांस्तथाऽऽश्रमान्। अन्वेषन्तो नलं राजन् नाधिजग्मुर्द्विजातयः॥
en: O king, thus advised, the Brahmanas departed in all directions in order to search for Nala, who had fallen into such great calamity. O monarch, the regenerate ones wandered in the cities, kingdoms, villages, the dwellings of the cowherds and the retreats of he sages in search of king Nala.

sa: सुमन्त्रिते सुनीते च सर्वतश्चोपपादिते। पौरुषे कर्मणि कृते नास्त्यधर्मो युधिष्ठिर॥
en: There is no sin, O Yudhishthira, in doing an act with full heart, after mature consideration and consultation with men capable of giving good advice.

sa: सन्ति पुत्राः सुबहवो दरिद्राणामनिच्छताम्। नास्तिः पुत्रः समृद्धानां विचित्रं विधिचेश्तिम्॥
en: The poor, although they may not desire it, have many children. The rich again are seen to have none. Wonderful is the course of Destiny.

sa: दृष्ट्वा विनिहताशूरान् पृथड्याण्डलिकान् नृपान्। बलिनश्च रणे कृष्ण नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: Seeing the many heroic and powerful kings, each master of extensive territories' killed in a battle, the all-destroying battle, O Krishna, did not still stop.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच दिष्ट्या पश्यामि वो मुक्तानीदृशात् पुरुषक्षयात्॥ पाण्डुकौरवसम्मर्दान्जीवमानान् नरर्षभान्।
en: Duryodhana said By good luck, I see you, O foremost of men, come back alive from this destructive battle between the Pandavas and the Kauravas.

sa: तथा कृष्णौ महेष्वासौ वृषभौ सर्वधन्विनाम्॥ शरैर्वीक्ष्य विनुन्नाङ्गौ प्रहृष्टा युद्धदुर्मदाः।
en: Beholding those two great bowmen, those two foremost of all warriors, viz., the two Krishnas, covered with arrows, those invincible (Kaurava) warriors filled with joy.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच इत्विजः कुञ्जरास्तत्र वाजिनोऽध्वर्यवस्तथा! हवींषि परमांसानि रुधिरं त्वाज्यमुच्यते॥
en: Elephants are the Ritwijas of that sacrifice, and horses are its Adhyaryus. The flesh of foes are its libations, and blood is its liquid offering.

sa: नारायणा हता यत्र गोपाला युद्धदुर्मदाः। म्लेच्छाश्च बहुसाहस्रा: किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: When the Narayanas have been slain as also the Gopalas, ever invincible in battle and many thousands of Mlecchas, who can it be but Destiny.

sa: प्रसादयेन्मधुरया वाचा वाप्यथ कर्मणा। तवास्मीति वदेन्नित्यं परेषां कीर्तयन् गुणान्॥
en: He should please all persons by. sweet words or good acts. He should say to all,-I am yours,-and declare the virtues of even his enemies.

sa: उदपानगताश्चापो व्यवर्धन्त समन्ततः। अशरीरा महानादाः श्रूयन्ते स्म तदा नृप॥
en: The water in the wells on all sides swelled up. Loud sounds came from every side without, O king, none to utter them being visible.

sa: अथ तत् कर्म दृष्ट्वास्याः प्रीतिस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरः। ततः संदर्शयामास कन्यायै रूपमात्मनः॥
en: Beholding this act of her, the lord of the three worlds, became highly pleased. He then appeared in his own proper form before the damsel.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच केवलानृण्यमाप्तास्मि गुरुपुत्रो गुरुर्मम। शिरस्येतं मणिं राजा प्रतिबध्नातु भारत॥
en: Draupadi said I desired only to satisfy our debt for the injury we have suffered. The preceptor's son deserves my respect as the preceptor himself.

sa: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य लब्धसंज्ञो महीपतिः। विललाप चिरं कालं पुत्राधिभिरभिप्लुतः॥
en: Regaining his senses, after a long time the monarch, wept for a long time, overwhelmed with grief on account of the death of his sons.

sa: मूर्खानिति परानाहं नात्मानं समवेक्षते। दोषान् क्षिपति चान्येषां नात्मानं शास्तुमिच्छति॥
en: One considers others as ignorant fools, but seldom gauges his own self. One attributes faults to others, but never wishes to punish his own self.

sa: महामना भवेद् धर्मे विवहेच्च महाकुले। ब्राह्मणांश्चापि सेवेत क्षमायुक्तान् मनस्विनः॥
en: He should be given to righteousness. He should make alliance with high families. He should serve the great Brahmanas endued with the virtue of forgiveness.

sa: तौ च तं विधिवद् राजन् पूज्यामासतुर्गुरुम्॥ ब्रह्मामिव देवेशमिन्द्रोपेन्द्रौ मुदान्वितौ।
en: Those two in return, O king, duly adored him, their superior, with great pleasure, like Indra and Upendra adoring Brahma the king of the celestials.

sa: त्रय्यां संवृतमन्त्रश्च राजा भवितुमर्हति। वृजिनं न नरेन्द्राणां नान्यच्चारक्षणात् परम्॥
en: The king should always keep his counsels close regarding these three. No greater misfortune can betake the king than the giving out of his counsels.

sa: हत्वा वा समरे पार्थान् स्फीतं राज्यमवाप्नुहि। निहतो वा रणेऽस्माभिर्वीरलोकमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Either killing the Parthas in battle make this prosperous kingdom your own or killed be us in battle go to the region reserved for heroes.

sa: यज्ञाझं दक्षिणा तात वेदानां परिबृंहणम्। न यज्ञा दक्षिणाहीनास्तारयन्ति कथंचन॥
en: Dakshina is one of the limbs of sacrifice and conduces to the nourishment of the Vedas. A sacrifice without Dakshina can never bring on salvation.

sa: न चैतत् कारपां ब्रह्मनल्पं विप्रतिभाति मे। यत्रागमदमेयात्मा स्वयमेव जनार्दनः॥
en: It seems to me, O Brahimana, that the cause could not be an insignificant one, since it was Janarddana had himself to make the journey.

sa: सा हि पुत्रवधं श्रुत्वा कृतमस्माभिरीदृशम्। मानसेनाग्निना क्रुद्धा भस्मसान्न: करिष्यति॥
en: Hearing of the death of her son in such a way, she will, in anger, with the fire of her mind, reduce us to ashes.

sa: सत्यसेनो रथेषां तु नकुलस्य धनुस्तथा॥ पृथक्छराभ्यां चिच्छेद कृतहस्त: प्रतापवान्।
en: The brave and light-handed Satyasena then cut off without his brother's help the shafts of Nakula's car and his bow with a couple of arrows.

sa: लेलिहानामिव विभो नागकन्यां महाविषाम्॥ समुद्यम्य च चिक्षेप सत्यसेनस्य संयुगे।
en: It resembled, O king, a she-snake of dreadful poison, frequently darting out her tongue. Raising that weapon he hurled it at Satyasena in that battle.

sa: शकुनिर्मातुलश्चैव कर्णश्च परमः सखा॥ समुत्पन्ना विनाशार्थं पृथिव्यां सहिता नृपाः।
en: Shakuni became his maternal uncle and Karna his great friend. Many other kings were born on Earth for helping him in the work of destruction.

sa: भगवानुशना चाह श्लोकमत्र विशाम्पते। तदिहैकमना राजन् गदतस्तं निबोध मे॥
en: On this subject, the holy Ushanas has recited a Sloka, o king, Listen to it with attention, O king, as I recite it to you.

sa: अधो हि वर्षमस्माकं नरास्तूर्ध्वप्रवर्षिणः। क्रियाव्युपरमात् तेषां ततो गच्छाम संशयम्॥
en: Men used to pour upwards while we used to pour downwards. For the stoppage of all religious rites among men we will suffer great distress.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा यमदूताभं मार्जारस्त्रस्तचेतनः॥ उवाच वचनं भीतः किमिदानीं करिष्यसि।
en: Seeing that who resembled a messenger of Yama, the cat was stricken with fear. Filled with fear, he addressed Palita, saying,-What will you do now?

sa: महता शङ्खनादेन रथनेमिस्वनेन च। ऊर्ध्वं धुन्वन् महारेणुं कम्पयंश्चापि मेदिनीम्॥
en: Raising a thick dust, that son of Pandu made the earth tremble with the sounds of his car-wheels and the loud blare of his conch.

sa: कृतः पुरुषकारश्च सोऽपि दैवेन सिध्यति। तथास्य कर्मणः कर्तुरभिनिवर्तते फलम्॥
en: Recourse may be had to manliness. But manliness succeeds through destiny. By the influence of destiny one who sets himself to work, attain to success.

sa: भवतस्तां सभां दृष्ट्वा समृद्धिं चाप्यनुत्तमाम्। दुर्योधनस्तदाऽऽसीनः सर्वं पित्रे न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Having seen that grand palace and that great prosperity of yours, Duryodhana, while sitting before his father described to him of all he had seen.

sa: क्षममाणं नृपं नित्यं नीचः परिभवेज्जनः। हस्तियन्ता गजस्यैव शिर एवारुरुक्षति॥
en: If the king becomes always forgiving, the lowest of persons influences him, as the driver who sits on the head of the elephant he guides.

sa: तस्य धर्मसुतो राजन् क्षुरप्रेण महाहवे। चक्ररक्षं जघानाशु मद्रराजस्य पार्थिवः॥
en: Then, O king, the son of Dharma, in that dreadful encounter, quickly cut off with a razor-headed arrow one of the guards of Shalya's car-wheels.

sa: पाण्डवैरवकीर्णानां सम्मोहः समजायत। न च जजुस्त्वनीकानि दिशो वा विदिशस्तथा॥
en: Overpowered by the Pandavas, the Kaurava army were stupefied. Indeed, those divisions then could not distinguish the cardinal and the minor points of the compass.

sa: व्यतिक्रान्तासु वर्षासु समये गमनस्य च। पर्वतो मामुवाचेदं काले वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: After the rains had gone, and when the time for our own departure arrived, Parvata said to me these weighty words suitable to the hour.

sa: शृणु कात्स्येन मत्तस्त्वं राजधर्मान् युधिष्ठिर। निरुच्यमानान् नियतो यच्चान्यदपि वाञ्छसि॥
en: Hear from me, O Yudhishthira, with rapt attention, all the royal duties described accurately and fully and other duties that you may wish to know.

sa: यथा वायुस्तृणाग्राणि संवर्तयति सर्वतः। तथा कालवशं यान्ति भूतानि भरतर्षभ॥
en: As the wind tears off the ends of all blades of grass, so all creatures, O Bharata chief, are subjected by Time under its influence.

sa: बलेनाथ स संस्तभ्य ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदैरयत्। ऐन्द्रं ततोऽर्जुनश्चापि तं दृष्ट्वाभ्युपमन्त्रयत्॥
en: Controlling himself with great exertion he brought the Brahma weapon into requisition beholding which Arjuna invoked the weapon given him by Indra with becoming mantras.

sa: आत्मार्थे संततिस्त्याज्या राज्यं रत्नं धनानि च॥ अपि सर्वस्वमुत्सृज्य रक्षेदात्मानमात्मना।
en: For protecting one's own self one should abandon his very children, kingdom, jewels, and wealth. One should sacrifice one's all for protecting one's own self.

sa: वणिजो नावि भिन्नाया यथागाधेऽप्लवेऽर्णवे। अपारे पारमिच्छन्तो हते शूरे महात्मना॥
en: Indeed, upon the slaughter of that hero by the illustrious Yudhishthira, your troops were like ship-wrecked merchants on the deep ocean want to cross it.

sa: यस्य स्फीतो जनपदः सम्पन्नः प्रियराजकः। संतुष्टभृत्यसचिवो दृढमूलः स पार्थिवः॥
en: That king, whose dominions are extensive and rich, whose subjects are loyal, whose servants and officers are all contented, is said to be firmly settled.

sa: यो ह्येकः पाण्डवैर्युध्येद् यो वा युध्यन्तमुत्सृजेत्। स पञ्चभिर्भवेद् युक्तः पातकैचोपपातकैः॥ (अद्याचार्यसुतो द्रौणिर्नैको युध्येत शत्रुभिः।) अन्योन्यं परिरक्षद्भिर्योद्धव्यं सहितैश्च ह।
en: And they said-"He who will fight alone with the Pandavas or he that will leave a comrade engaged in fight, will be visited by the five grave and all the minor sins.”—–And they said-"Do not fight Ashvatthama alone, son of Drona. All of us, unitedly will fight with the enemy.

sa: न हि प्रहर्तुमिच्छन्ति शूराः प्रद्रवतो भृशम्। तस्मात् पलायमानानां कुर्यान्नात्यनुसारणम्॥
en: Brave warriors do not wish to strike them that run away quickly. That is another reason why the scattered foe should not be pursued hotiy.

sa: आशीविषैश्च तस्याहुः संगतं यस्य राजभिः। बहुमित्राश्च राजानो बह्वमित्रास्तथैव च॥
en: He who has any connection with kings is said to have connection with snakes of deadly venom. Kings have many friends as also many enemies.

sa: अयं स हन्ता शूराणां मित्राणाप्रभयप्रदः। प्रदाता गोसहस्राणां क्षत्रियान्तकरः करः॥
en: Here is that arm which killed enemies and dispelled the fears of friends, which gave thousands of kine and rotted out the Kshatriyas in battle.

sa: ततः पापतरं कर्म कृतवानपि सात्यकिः। यस्मात् प्रायोविष्टस्य प्राहार्षीत् संशितात्मनः॥
en: Alas, Satyaki perpetrated a still more sinful act, for he killed a person of restrained soul while sitting in the observance of the praya VOW.

sa: कुर्वन्ति च चितामेते जटिला ब्रह्मचारिणः। धनुभिः शक्तिभिश्चैव रथनीडैश्च माधव॥
en: Those Brahmana saints, with matted locks on their head, have made the funeral pyre of that Brahmana with bows and arrows and carboxes, O Madhava.

sa: शूरवाहुषु लोकोऽयं लम्बते पुत्रवत् सदा। तस्मात् सर्वास्ववस्थासु शूरः सम्मानमर्हति॥
en: This world depends on the arms of heroes like a son on those of his father. A hero, therefore, should be honoured under every circumstance.

sa: भरतं चैव दौष्यन्तिं मृतं संजय शुश्रुमा शाकुन्तलं महात्मानं भूरिद्रविणसंचयम्॥
en: We hear, O Srinjaya, that the great Bharata also the son of Dushyanta and Shakuntala, who had a vast and well-replenished treasury met with death.

sa: दक्षिणं मण्डलं सव्यं गोमूत्रकमथापि च। व्यचरत् पाण्डवो राजन्नरिं सम्मोहयन्निव॥
en: Sometimes adopting the right Mandala, sometimes the left Mandala, and sometines Gomutraka, the son of Pandu began to move about, O king, stupefying his foe.

sa: कुलीनः कुलसम्पन्नस्तितिक्षुर्दक्ष आत्मवान्। शूरः कृतज्ञः सत्यश्च श्रेयसः पार्थ लक्षणम्॥
en: High birth, purity of blood, forgiveness, cleverness, and purify of mind, bravery gratefulness, and truthfulness are, O son of Pritha, characteristic of superiority and goodness.

sa: आवामस्य नरेन्द्रस्य गृहे परमपूजितौ। उषितौ समये ब्रह्मस्तद् विचिन्तय साम्प्रतम्॥
en: We have, O Brahmana, lived in the house of this king for some time, highly respected by him. Think of what return we should make.

sa: उत्थायोत्याय गच्छेत नित्ययुक्तो रिपोर्गृहान्। कुशलं चास्य पृच्छेत यद्यप्यकुशलं भवेत्॥
en: The king should, always, with careful application, go to the houses of his enemies, and even if calamities overtake them, ask them about their well-being.

sa: एतेन किल पार्थस्य युद्धमासीत् सुदारुणम्। रोमहर्षणमत्युग्रं शक्रस्य त्वहिना यथा॥
en: Dreadful was the battle that took place between this king and Partha, making the hairs stand erect, like that between Shakra and the Asura Vritra.

sa: अनुतर्षुलमेवैतद् दुःखं भवति मारिष। राज्यनाशं सुहन्नाशं सुतनाशं च भारत॥
en: The loss of kingdom of friends, and of children, O Bharata, and such other things, visit him who is still under the influence of desire.

sa: पुरा कृतयुगे राजंश्चार्वाको नाम राक्षसः। तपस्तेपे महाबाहो बदाँ बहुवार्षिकम्॥
en: Formerly, in the Krita age, O king, a Rakshasa of the name of Charvaka, O mightyarmed one, practised austere penances for many years in Badari.

sa: यो मोहयति भूतानि स्नेहपाशानुबन्धनैः। सर्गस्य रक्षणार्थाय तस्मै मोहात्मने नमः॥
en: You stupefy all creatures by the letters of affection and love for the continuance of the creation. Salutations to you in your form of stupefaction.

sa: अनुज्ञातस्त्वहं तेन न्यस्तवर्मा निरायुधः। प्रातिष्ठं येन नगरं सायढे रुधिरोक्षितः॥
en: Permitted by him, myself then putting off my armour and surrendering my weapons, started in the evening for the city, my limbs covered with blood.

sa: पीडितास्तावकाः सर्वे प्रधावन्तो रणोत्कटाः। क्षणेन चैव पार्थस्ते बहुत्वात् समलोडयन्॥
en: Although assailed still those troops, who were fierce in battle, rushing against the Parthas, very soon agitated them on account of the superiority in numbers.

sa: यद्वाच्यं हितकामेन सुहृदा हितमिच्छता। तथा दिवाकरेणोक्तः स्वप्नान्ते मम चाग्रतः॥
en: That god said to Karna in a dream and once more in my presence, all that a well-wishing friend, from desire of good, should say.

sa: स गङ्गामनु वृन्दानि स्त्रीणां भरतसत्तम। कुररीणामिवार्तानां क्रोशन्तीनां ददर्श ह॥
en: Yudhishthira saw near the banks of the Ganges, O king, the crowd of Bharata ladies afflicted with sorrow and crying like a light of she-ospreys.

sa: मृत्युरात्मेच्छया यस्य जातस्य मनुजेष्वपि! तथानपत्यस्य सतः पुण्यलोका दिवि श्रुताः॥
en: Although born as man, his death itself is in his own hands. Although childless, yet he has many blissful regions hereafter as heard by us.

sa: प्रागेव तु महाबुद्धिर्बुद्ध्वा तस्येङ्गितं हरिः। संविधानं महाप्राज्ञस्तत्र चक्रे जनार्दनः॥
en: The highly intelligent, Krishna had, in the very beginning understood the object of Dhritarashtra, and had, therefore, kept such a contrivance ready for baffling them.

sa: घातयित्वा वयस्यांश्च भ्रातूनथ पितूंस्तथा। पुत्रान् पौत्रांस्तथा चान्यांस्ततोऽसि निधनं गतः॥
en: Having brought about the death of your companions and brothers and sires and sons and grandsons and others you now meet with your own death!

sa: तान् भीमसेनः संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। बलेन चतुरङ्गेन संवृत्याजघ्नतुः शरैः॥
en: Then worked up with anger Bhimasena and Prisata's son Dhristadyumna encircled them with four kinds of forces and began to strike them with their arrows.

sa: विलोड्यमाने तस्मिंस्तु स्रुततोये जलाशये। अगच्छद् बन्धनं तत्र दीर्घसूत्रः सहापरैः॥
en: Then they began to agitate the little remaining water, and as they began to catch the fish, the idle Shakula was caught with many others.

sa: तस्माच्च धर्मचरणानीतिर्देवी सरस्वती। ससृजे दण्डनीतिं सा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता॥
en: From that form, having Righteousness for its legs, the goddess Sarasvati created Dandaniti (Science of Punishment) which very soon became celebrated all over the world.

sa: ततो नः सम्प्रयातानां हता मद्रास्तरस्विनः॥ हृष्टाः किलकिलाशब्दमकुर्वन् सहिताः परे।
en: Then, whilst we were proceeding, the active Pandavas, in a body, completed the slaughter of the Madrakas and filled with delight, sent up joyous shouts.

sa: नित्यं बुद्धिमतोऽप्यर्थः स्वल्पकोऽपि विवर्धते। दाक्ष्ये' कुर्वतः कर्म मंयपात् प्रतितिष्ठति॥
en: The wealth, however little, of an intelligent man is certain to increase. Such a man does every act cleverly. By self-restraint he acquires great fame.

sa: अथ सुव्याहृतं श्रुत्वा तस्य शत्रोविचक्षणः। हेतुमद् ग्रहणीयार्थं मार्जारो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these well-selected, reasonable and good words of the mouse, the mouse's enemy, endued with judgement and forethought, the cat said these words in reply.

sa: न हि बुद्ध्यान्वितः प्राज्ञो नीतिशास्त्रविशारदः॥ निमज्जत्यापदं प्राप्य महतीं दारुणामपि॥
en: An intelligent and wise person and conversant with the science of policy never sinks, however great and terrible may be the danger which threatens him.

sa: स तैः परिवृतः शूर सर्वतोऽतिस्थैर्भृशम्। व्यचरत् समरे राजन् दर्शयन्नस्त्रलाघवम्॥
en: Surrounded by those great warriors on every side, the Panchala hero, O king, moved in the battle-field, displaying his quickness in the use of weapons.

sa: वत्सौपम्येन दोग्धव्यं राष्ट्रमक्षीणबुद्धिना॥ भृतो वत्सो जातबल: पीडां सहति भारत।
en: An intelligent king should milk his kingdom like calves. If the calf be permitted to suck, it grows strong, O Bharata, and carries heavy loads.

sa: ततस्ते प्राविशन् पार्था हतत्विट्कं हतेश्वरम्। दुर्योधनस्य शिबिरं रङ्गवद्विसृते जने॥
en: The Parthas then entered the tent of Duryodhana, shorn of its splendours and bereft of its master, and looking like a pleasureground deserted by spectators.

sa: यथाऽऽरुह्य महावृक्षमपहृत्य ततो मधु। अप्राश्य निधनं गच्छेत् कर्मेदं नस्तथोपमम्॥
en: Or, this our act is like that of a person who having climbed up a tall tree and collected honey therefrom dies before tasting it.

sa: यदब्रवीत् स धर्मात्मा विदुरो दीर्घदर्शिवान्। तत्तथा समनुप्राप्तं वचनं सत्यवादिनः॥
en: What the pious Vidura, conversant with the attributes of everything, then said, had proved true, for the words he uttered were nothing but the truth.

sa: निश्चयः स्वार्थशास्त्रेषु विश्वासश्चासुखोदयः। उशना चैव गाथे द्वे प्रह्लादायाब्रवीत् पुरा॥
en: Men well read in scriptures have laid it down that trust never yields happiness. Ushanas himself sang two verses to Prahlada in days of yore.

sa: यथाऽऽश्रित्य महावृक्षं कक्षः संवर्धते महान्। ततस्तं संवृणोत्येव तमतीत्य च वर्धते॥ तेनैयोगेन्धनेनैनं दावो दहति दारुणः। तथोपमा ह्यमात्यास्ते राजस्तान् परिशोधय॥
en: Parasites, supported by a huge tree, grow luxuriously, and at last covering the tree itself overshadow it entirely. A forest fire sets in, and catching those grasses first, consumes the tree with them. Thy ministers, O king, resemble those parasites of which I speak, Do you check and correct them.

sa: दुर्योधनमुपागम्य प्राह प्रहरतां वरः। दुर्योधन तवामित्रान् प्रख्यातान् युद्धदुमदान्॥ पाण्डवान् हन्तुमिच्छामि त्वयाऽऽज्ञप्तः सहानुगान्। जटासुरो मम पिता रक्षसां ग्रामणीः पुरा॥
en: That best of smiters, approaching Duryodhana said these words-"O Duryodhana, with your permission, do I intend to slay the Pandava brothers and their followers who are your inveterate enemies and who are regarded as indomitable in battle. My father was Jatasura that foremost of the Rakshasas, endued with great prowess.

sa: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल पौरुषेण समास्थितः। क्षत्रधर्म पुरस्कृत्य प्रत्युद्याहि धनंजयम्॥
en: O foremost of men, for these reasons and remembering the duties of the Kshatriyas you should put forth all your energies and march against Dhananjaya.

sa: त्वत्कृते ह्यहमद्राक्षं दह्यमानां वरूथिनीम्। सहस्रशः शरैर्मुक्तैः पाण्डवेन वृषेण च॥
en: It was through your fault that I had to see our army consumed in thousands by the shafts discharged by Pandu's son and by Vrisha.

sa: तमुद्यतं महाघोरं परिघं तस्य सूतजः॥ व्यहनत् सायकै राजन् सुतीक्ष्णैर्भारसाधनैः।
en: O monarch, the son of Suta had struck down that dreadful mace, uplifted by him, with the keenest arrows, capable of bearing the greatest strain.

sa: उपारमन्त ते सर्वे योधा भरतसत्तम। अदृष्टपूर्वं पश्यन्तस्तद् युद्धं गुरुशिष्ययोः॥
en: Beholding that battle between the preceptor and pupil, of which no equal was seen before, the other warriors desisted from fighting and began to tremble.

sa: रमन्ते चोपहासने पुरुषाः पुरुषैः सह अन्योन्यमवतक्षन्तो देशे देशे समैथुनाः॥
en: In every country there are kings observant of their own religions and engaged in repressing the wicked. And in every country there are virtuous men.

sa: तौ तु दृष्ट्वा व्यतिक्रान्तौ द्रोणानीकं महायुती। नाशशंसुर्महाराज सिन्धुराजस्य जीवितम्॥
en: But beholding those two highly effulgent warriors now beyond the division of Drona, they became doubtful about the life of the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: ननु नाम त्वया वीर दीर्यमाणा भयार्दिता। स्वबाहुबलमास्थाय रक्षितव्य ह्यनीकिनी॥
en: Indeed, O hero, this army, shattered and afflicted with fear as it is, ought to be protected by you, by your own strength of arms.

sa: भीमात् खलु समुत्पन्नः कुरूणां विपुले कुले॥ पाण्डवानामहं पुत्रः समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम्।
en: I am born of Bhima in the great race of the Kurus and am the son of the Pandavas who never run away from battle.

sa: पितामहत्वं सम्प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डुपुत्रा महारणे। रक्षितास्तात भीष्मेण दिवसानि दशैव तु॥
en: Beholding their connection of grand-father with themselves, the sons of Pandu, O father, were saved in that formidable battle by Bhishma for ten consecutive days.

sa: नाभिजानन्ति चान्योन्यं कश्मलाभिहतौजसः। पुत्रान् पितॄन् सखीन् भ्रातृन् समारोप्य दृढक्षतान्॥
en: Some causing their sons, fathers, friends and brothers sit (on their vehicles) and doffing their coats of inail were seen to wash them with water.

sa: स वीर्यमाणो विशिखैः समन्तात्तैर्महारथैः॥ भीमः क्रोधाग्निरक्ताक्षः क्रुद्ध काल इवाबभौ।
en: Being hemmed in on all sides by the arrows of those mighty car warriors, Bhima, with fiery and blood-red, eyes, looked brilliant as Pluto himself.

sa: अथ कर्णो भृशं क्रुद्धः शीघ्रमस्त्रमुदीरयन्। जघान पाण्डवीं सेनामासुरीं मघवानिव॥
en: Then worked with great anger and invoking speedily his weapons Karna began to assail the Pandava host like Indra grinding the army of the demons.

sa: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि यानि शिष्टानि भारत॥ रथानामयुतं चैव त्रिसाहस्त्राश्च दन्तिनः।
en: O Bharata! there remained living as much as fourteen thousand infantry soldiers, ten thousand chariot riders and three thousand elephants with Samsaptakas (Kauravas) till then.

sa: अपोवाह रणाद् वीरं सोमदत्तं महारथम्। तं विसंज्ञं समालक्ष्य युयुधानशरार्दितम्॥
en: Carried away the heroic and mighty carwarrior Somadatta from (the field of) battle. Beholding him deprived of senses and afflicted with the arrows of Yuyudhana.

sa: स रश्मिषु विषक्तत्वादुत्ससर्ज शरासनम्। धनुषा कर्म कुर्वस्तु रश्मींश्च पुनरुत्सृजत्॥
en: For holding the reins Dushasana once laid his bow aside, again, for using the bow the took up the reins. (Thus did he then fight).

sa: तुल्यतां द्रोणभीष्माभ्यामात्मनो यो न मृष्यते। वासुदेवार्जुनाभ्यां च न्यूनतां नैच्छातात्मनि॥
en: He (Pandya) does not admit that he cqual to either Karna or Bhishma; nor docs he wish that he is inferior to Vasudeva or Arjuna.

sa: स ताम्रनयनः क्रोधाच्छ्वसन्निव महोरगः। बभौ कर्णः शरानस्यन् रश्मीनिव दिवाकरः॥
en: With his eyes coppery in rage and breathing like a fierce snake, Karna then shooting arrows, appeared beautiful like the sun shooting his myriad rays.

sa: नारायण बलभद्राः शूराश्च शतशोऽपरे। अनुरक्ताश्च वीरेण भीष्मेण युधि पातिताः॥
en: The Narayanas, the Vallavas, the Ramas and hundreds of others warriors, attached to the Pandavas in the field, were all slain by Bhishma in battle.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु राधेयं नवत्या नतपर्वणाम्। विव्याध समरे क्रुद्धो जत्रुदेशे महाबलः॥
en: The redoubtable Bhimasena, boiling with rage, assailed the son of Radha, in that battle, with ninty straight shafts and hit him (also) in the shoulder-joint.

sa: वासुदेववचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। मुहूर्तं चिन्तयित्वा तु ततो दारुणमाहवम्॥ प्रायाद् द्रुतममित्रनो यत्र भीमो व्यवस्थितः। विनिप्रंस्तावकान् योधान् व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः॥५३
en: Hearing these words of Vasudeva, the virtuous king Yudhishthira reflected for a moment and then proceeded towards the spot where the battle was raging hot and furious and where, Bhima, the slayer of his foes, taking up his station, was destroying your warriors like the (grim) Destroyer with gaping mouth.

sa: तत: क्रुद्धो महाराज सहदेवः प्रतापवान्। समाधत्त शरं घोरं मृत्युकालान्तकोपमम्॥
en: O mighty monarch, the most powerful Shahadeva, being highly enraged at this, fixed an arrow on his bow, that was as deadly as Death himself.

sa: यस्य नास्ति समो योधः कौरवेषु कथंचन। सोऽयमायाति कौन्तेय सात्यकिर्युद्धदुर्मदः॥
en: Invincible in battle, that Satyaki who has no match for him in the whole Kaurava army, is now coming to you, O son of Kunti!

sa: ते हित्वा समरे कर्ण वध्यमानाश्च सायकैः। प्रदुद्रुवुर्दिशो भीताश्चक्रुशुश्चापि सूतजम्॥
en: Distressed to death by (Arjuna's) shafts they all, leaving Karna, began to disperse themselves on all directions abusing the son of Suta all the time.

sa: कर्णेन च कृतो राजा विमुखः शत्रुतापनः। बलवाँल्लघुहस्तश्च कृती युद्धविशारदः॥
en: The powerful light-handed and successful king Yudhishthira, expert in fighting and the scorcher of his enemies, was compelled by Karna to retreat from the battle-field.

sa: ततः खं पूरयामास शरैर्दिव्यास्त्रमन्त्रितैः। युधिष्ठिरं च समरे परिवार्य महास्त्रवित्॥
en: Thereupon he filled the sky with arrows of the vigour of celestial weapons. That one, conversant with the use of weapons, withstood Yudhishthira in battle.

sa: ततः प्रायाद् रथेनाशु बीभत्सोर्वचनाद्धरिः॥ यतो युधिष्ठिरो राजा सृञ्जयाश्च महारथाः।
en: Thereupon at the request of Vibhatsu Hari speedily moved the course of his car where king Yudhishthira and the valiant Srinjayas were fighting to death.

sa: विहतायां तु मायायाममर्षी स घटोत्कचः। विससर्ज शरान् घोरांस्तेऽश्वत्थामानमाविशन्॥ भुजङ्गा इव वेगेन वल्मीकं क्रोधमूर्छिताः। ते शरा रुधिराक्ताङ्गा भित्त्वा शारद्वतीसुतम्॥
en: Enraged at the illusion being dispelled (by the son of Drona), Ghatotkacha began to discharge fierce arrows. Those (arrows) penetrated into (the body of) Asvatthama. As snakes insensible with rage furiously (enter into) an ant-hill, those arrows penetrating through (the body of) the son of Saradvata became covered with blood.

sa: रुधिरौघवतीं कृत्वा नदीं शोणितकर्दमाम्। तृणवद् व्यस्य कौरव्यानेष ह्यायाति सात्यकिः॥
en: Yonder comes Satyaki, having created a river of blood with clots of blood for its mire and having disregarded the Kauravas like some any straws."

sa: तस्मै गुर्वी गदां धोरां विनदन्नुत्ससर्ज ह। ततस्तां भीमनि?षामापतन्तीं महागदाम्॥
en: Hurled a heavy and dreadful mace at the Rakshasa, uttering a fierce roar. Then as that mighty mace a fierce roar was flying towards him.

sa: शीघ्रं न्यस्यत शस्त्राणि वाहेभ्यश्चावरोहत। एष योगोऽत्र विहितः प्रतिषेधे महात्मना॥
en: “Quickly throw aside your weapons and come down from your vehicles; even this is the means ordained by the high-souled Narayana, for baffling this weapon.

sa: महागिरौ वेणुवनं निशि प्रज्वलितं यथा।॥ तथा तव महासैन्यं प्रास्फुरच्छरपीडितम्।
en: As on a night, a blazing forest of bamboos burns on a great mountain, so your great army looked ablaze under fire from (Arjuna's) shots.

sa: मध्याह्ने तपतो राजन् भास्करस्य महाप्रभाः॥ हृताः सर्वाः शरौघैस्तैः कर्णपाण्डवयोस्तदा।
en: The fierceness of the sun's rays burring at midday was removed by those thick showers of arrows discharged by Karna and the son of Pandu.

sa: श्रेणयो बहुसाहस्त्राः संशप्तकगणाश्च ये। ते सर्वे पार्थमासाद्य गता वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Having approached Partha, many thousands of the Sreni warriors, as well as the army of the Samsaptakas, all these departed to the abode of Death.

sa: अब्रवीद् वचनं राजन् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। यः सदेवान् सगन्धर्वान् दैत्यांश्चैकरथोऽजयत्॥ तस्य लक्ष्म न पश्यामि भीमसेनानुजस्य ते। ततोऽब्रवीद् धर्मराजं भीमसेनस्तथागतम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira the son of Kunti addressing him said-"O Bhima, I do not see the banner-device of that younger brother of mine, who on a single car vanquished the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Daityas in battle." Thereupon Bhima addressing the virtuous Yudhishthira who was in that pitiable plight said

sa: संजय उवाच प्रसाद्यमानस्तु तनो राज्ञा द्रौणिर्महामनाः। प्रससाद महाराज क्रोधवेगसमन्वितः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus appeased by the king, the highminded son of Drona, O great king, who was filled with a furious rage subdued his anger.

sa: व्यपेक्षा नैव कर्तव्या गतोऽस्तमिति भास्करः॥ एवमस्त्विति बीभत्सुः केशवं प्रत्यभाषत।
en: You should not then give up the enterprise thinking the sun to have already set. "Then Vibhatsu replied to Keshava saying “let it be so."

sa: शीघ्रं गच्छतं भद्रं वो राधेयं परिरक्षत। भीमसेनभयागाधे मजन्तं व्यसनार्णवे॥
en: May good betide you! Go quickly and rescue the son of Radha who is plunged into the fathomless calamity consequent upon the fear of Bhimasena.

sa: पुत्रः पाञ्चालराजस्य धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः॥ द्रौणिमित्यब्रवीद् वाक्यं दृष्ट्वा योधान् निपतितान्।
en: That great car-warrior, Dhristadyumna, the son of the king of Panchala, beholding the carnage of his warriors, said these words to the son of Drona.

sa: सौबलं कृतवर्माणं द्रौणिमाधिरथिं कुपम्॥ संसक्तान् पाण्डवैर्दृष्ट्वा निवृत्ताः कुरवः पुनः।
en: Beholding the son of Subala, Kritavarma, Drona's son, Adhiratha's son and Kripa fight with the Pandavas the Kauravas rallied and came back to the battle.

sa: कृतवर्मा महेष्वासः सात्वतानां महारथः॥ हतं वैकर्तनं दृष्ट्वा हार्दिक्यः किमभाषत।
en: Beholding the son of Vikartana (slain in battle), what did that son of Hridika, Kritavarman, that mighty bowman, that great car-warrior amongst the Satvatas, say?

sa: ते रात्रौ कृतकर्माणः श्रान्ताः सूर्यस्य तेजसा। क्षत्पिपासापरीताङ्गा विसंज्ञा बहवोऽभवन्॥
en: Having fought hard during the previous night many combatants, worn out with toil and weak with hunger and thirst, lost their senses in a swoon.

sa: हत्वा च पाण्डवान् युद्धे स्फीतामुर्वीमवात्स्यथ। निहता वा परैयुद्धे वीरलोकमवाप्स्यथ॥
en: Either having slain the Pandavas let them acquire the prosperous kingdom or being slain by the enemies let them repair to the region of heroes.

sa: अथाभिपत्य वेगेन समुद्धाम्य च राक्षसम्। बलेनाक्षिप्य हैडिम्बिश्चकर्तास्य शिरो महत्॥
en: Then rushing with great violence and whirling the Rakshasa on high and dashing him down again, Hidimba's son cut-off the large head of his adversary.

sa: अनलानिलयोस्तुल्यं तेजसा न बलेन च। पातालमिव गम्भीरं सुहृदां नन्दिवर्धनम्॥
en: Who was irrepressible even unto the gods headed by Vasava in a great battle and was like unto fire and wind in energy and strength;

sa: त्वं हि कृष्णाय कर्णाच विशिष्टो राजशार्दूल नास्ति तत्र विचारणा॥
en: Chiefly you are, indeed, superior to Krishna and to Karna, as well as to Phalguna, O foremost of monarch, there is no doubt about this.

sa: संसक्तान्येव चादृश्यन् रथवृन्दानि मारिष॥ हतानि च विकीर्णानि शरीराणि शरीरिणाम्।
en: () sire, the chariots were then entangled with one another; thousands of corpses of slain creatures were also seen lying on the field of battle.

sa: विभावरीमुखे व्योम खद्योतैरिव चित्रितम्॥ निशाम्य निहतां मायां द्रौणिना रणमानिना।
en: That the firmament was studded with glowworms during the night. Beholding his illusion destroyed by the son of Drona, proud (of his prowess) in battle.

sa: तेषां दृष्ट्वा तु क्रुद्धानां वपूष्यमिततेजसाम्॥ अभवन्मेभयं तीव्र कथमेतद् भविष्यति।
en: Beholding the bodies of those highly energetic and wrathful heroes my mind was possessed by great fear and I thought, "what will become of them?

sa: चतुर्भिश्चतुरो वाहंस्तस्य हत्वा महारथः। पञ्चमेन शिरः कायात् सारथेश्च समाक्षियत्॥
en: Then that powerful car-warrior, having slaughtered his (Duryodhana's) four horses with four arrows, with the fifth severed the head of his charioteer from his body.

sa: संजयेष्वथ सर्वेषु निहतेषु चमूमुखे। धृष्टद्युम्नं रणे द्रौणिर्हनिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: When all the Srinjayas, (placed) in the van of the (Pandava) army will be destroyed, the son of Drona will undoubtedly slay Dhristadyumna in battle.

sa: यचापि तान् प्रव्रजतः कृष्णाजिननिवासिनः। परुषाण्युक्तवान् कर्णः सभायां संनिधौ तव॥
en: Recollecting also those words, harsh and cruel, uttered by Karna, when the sons of Pandu were about to go to the forest, clad in deerskins;

sa: ततो दश दिशः कर्णः शलभैरिव यायिभिः॥ अभ्यघ्नंस्तरसा राजशरैः परशरीरगैः।
en: With arrows capable of piercing the bodies of the enemies and advancing quickly Karna covered the ten quarters as if with a swarm of locusts.

sa: राज्ञस्ते वचनाद् राजन् पञ्चालाः सृञ्जयास्तथा। द्रोणमेवाभ्यवर्तन्त नदन्तो भैरवान् रवान्॥
en: In obedience to the commands of the king, the Panchalas as well as the Srinjayas O monarch, sending forth thundering roars, rushed against Drona alone.

sa: तापनं सर्वसैन्यानां घोररूपं सुदारुणम्। समावृत्य महासेनां ज्वलन्तं स्वेन तेजसा॥
en: The awful form of that weapon, spreading terror and consternation all round and encompassing the vast array of troops, is glistening with its own bright.

sa: व्यश्वसूतरथं चैनं द्रौणिश्चक्रे महाहवे। तस्य चानुचरान् सर्वान् क्रुद्धः प्राद्रावयच्छरैः॥
en: Drona's son deprived his opponent of his horses, chariot and driver; and he, worked up with rage, covered the latter's followers with myriads of arrows.

sa: स भीमं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा राधेयः प्रहसन्निव। पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या स्वर्णपुङः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Thereupon the son of Radha smilingly piercing Bhima with five shafts, once more pierced him with seventy shafts furnished with golden wings whetted on stone.

sa: विद्धानां शतशो राजश्रूयते नि:स्वनो महान्। शृणु दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषमर्जुनस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: Hark, O king, the terrible wails of foremost warriors as they fly or fall in battle in consequence of shafts shot from the Gandiva bow.

sa: भीमास्त्रेण सुनिर्भग्नान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् महारथान्॥ धृष्टद्युम्नमुखा वीरा घ्नन्ति शत्रून् सहस्रशः।
en: The heroes, headed by Dhristadyumna, are killing thousands of their enemies, the great car-warriors of Duryodhana's force, already sunk in the ocean of Bhima's weapons.

sa: आस्थितः स स्थश्रेष्ठं कर्णः शरगभस्तिमान्।॥ प्रबभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ मन्दरस्थ इवांशुमान्।
en: Stationed on that best of cars Karna, the foremost of men, with the rays of his shafts, looked like the sun on the mount Mandara.

sa: न त्विदं सहसा ब्रह्मन् प्रयोक्तव्यं कथंचन। न ह्येतदस्रमन्यत्र वधाच्छवोर्निवर्तते॥
en: But, O Brahmana, this weapon should not be used without sufficient deliberation, for it never returns without dispatching the foc at whom it is hurled.

sa: निक्षेपस्यन्ति च शस्राणि वाहनेभ्योऽवरुह्य ये। तान्नैतदत्रं संग्रामे निहनिष्यति मानवान्॥
en: Those men, on the other hand, who will thrown down their weapons and alight form their vehicles, will not be slain by this weapon. yourselves.

sa: स पपात द्विधाछिन्न आयसः परिघो महान्। महीधरस्येव महच्छिखरं वज्रदारितम्॥
en: Thus severed into two parts, that great Parigha of iron, fell down (on the ground) like the great peak of a mountain riven by thunder.

sa: पार्थिवः। प्रायाद् द्रोणरथं प्रेप्सुर्युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः। ततः पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रः समादुर्मदः॥
en: Followed Yuyudhana from behind, with a view to reach the chariot of Drona. Thereafter, the son of the king of the Panchalas, that invincible warrior.

sa: तस्मिन् हते महेष्वासे राजपुत्रे महाबले। पञ्चालास्त्वरिता द्रोणं समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: When that highly puissant and fierce bowmen, that prince of the Panchalas, had been slain, the Panchalas, in all haste, surrounded Drona on all sides.

sa: शरसम्भिन्नवर्माणौ तावुभौ भ्रातरौ रणे। सात्यकिं सत्यकर्माणं राजन् विव्यधतुः शरैः॥
en: O monarch, these two heroic brothers whose vital parts were deeply struck with the arrows, pierced Satyaki, who always performed appropriate deeds with their shafts,

sa: अद्य हाहाकृता दीना विषण्णास्त्वच्छरार्दिताः॥ प्रपतन्तं रथात् कर्णं पश्यन्तु वसुधाधिपाः।
en: Let the lords of this hemisphere, seeing Karna fall today from off his chariot, covered with your shafts, despondent and heart-broken, indulge themselves in grief.

sa: पश्यतेमौ हि मे बाहू नागराजकरोपमौ। समर्थौ पर्वतस्यापि शैशिरस्य निपातने॥
en: Look at my strong arms like the trunks of the foremost of elephants. They are capable of pulling down the crests of the Himavat mountain.

sa: प्रत्युद्ययुस्तं त्वरिताः पञ्चाला जयगृद्धिनः॥ तान् द्रोणः प्रतिजग्राह परीप्सन् कुरुसत्तमम्।
en: The Panchalas too desirous of victory speedily followed the king. In order to save the foremost of the Kurus, Drona received them (i.e., their charge).

sa: संजय उवाच अश्वत्थामानमुक्त्वैवं ततः सौबलमब्रवीत्। वृतं रथसहस्रेण हयानां रणशोभिनाम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus addressing Ashvatthama, he then said to the son of Subala-"(Arjuna) is surrounded by one hundred thousand cars, adorning the (field of) battle.

sa: नागानां प्रास्फुटन् कुम्भा मर्माणि विविधानि च। दन्ताश्चैवातिविद्धानां नाराचैर्भूषणानि च॥
en: The frontal globes and several other vitals, the tusks and the equipments of the elephants, that were deeply pierced with long shafts, were all shattered.

sa: ततो व्योम्नि विषक्तानि शरजालानि भागशः। आहतानि व्यशीर्यन्त भीमसेनस्य पत्रिभिः॥
en: Then the net-work of arrows spread in the skies by Kamna, began to be shattered and torn, being struck with the winged arrows of Bhimasena.

sa: श्रेयसस्त्वद्धिते युक्तांस्तत्तद् वक्तुमिहेच्छसि। गच्छ त्वमपि कौन्तेयमात्मार्थे जहि मा चिरम्॥
en: Go yourself to resist the son of Kunti, at your own risk. You are well-born and a Kshatriya too; you are again desirous of battle.

sa: रथाः स्वनन्ति चात्यर्थं हयाश्चाश्रूण्यवासृजन्। हतौजा इव चाप्यासीद् भारद्वाजो महारथः॥
en: Cars emitted loud clatters and horses began to shed tears. The mighty car-warrior Drona the son of Bhardvaja, appeared to be devoid of his energy.

sa: पुनः पञ्चाशतेषूणां शितेन च समापयत्। लघुतां युयुधानस्य लाघवेन विशेषयन्॥
en: Then once more he pierced him with fifty and hundred shafts successively, thus surpassing with his own lightness of hands the lightness displayed by Yuyudhana.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्य यो मृत्युः सृष्टस्तेन महात्मना। यथा द्रोणस्य पाञ्चाल्यो यज्ञसेनसुतोऽभवत्॥
en: Ashvatthaman was destined to become the slayer of Dhristadyumna the son of Yajnasena, even as this latter was ordained to be the slayer of Drona.

sa: हतवीरमिदं सैन्यं पाण्डवैः समरे विभो। कर्णो ोको महाबाहुरस्मत्प्रियहिते रतः॥
en: O lord, this my force has lost the most heroic warriors, who were all slain by the sons of Pandu in the field of battle.

sa: अमर्षयन्तो निहतं शतचन्द्रं महारथम्॥ शकुने_तरो वीरा गवाक्षः शरभो विभुः।
en: Unable to put up with the destruction of that great car-warrior Satachandra, the brothers of Shakuni viz., the heroic Gavaksha, Sarava, Vibhu (and two others).

sa: भगदत्त सुतो राजन् कृतप्रज्ञो महाबलः। श्येनवचरता संख्ये नकुलेन निपातितः॥
en: O monarch, the highly powerful and wise son of Bhagadatta was slain by Nakula, who moved about in the field of) battle like a hawk.

sa: धर्मराजस्य तद् वाक्यं नाभिशङ्कितुमर्हसि। एवमुक्तस्ततो द्रोणो भीमेनोत्सृज्य तद् धनुः॥
en: It behoves you not to doubt the words the very virtuous king Yudhishthira has told you, Thus addressed by Bhima, Drona, laid his bow aside.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं च समासाद्य पार्थः काम्बोजरक्षितम्। प्रममाथ बलं बाणैर्दनवानिव वासवः॥
en: Approaching the wing which was being defended by Kamboja he began to harass the troops by his powerful arrows as Vasava had harassed the Danavas.

sa: हाहाकृतानि भूतानि मानुषाणीतराणि च। द्रोणं तथागतं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नवशं गतम्॥
en: Then men and other creatures beholding Drona on the point of falling a victim to Dhristadyumna, began to utter loud cries of Oh and Alas.

sa: हाहाकारं भृशं चक्रुरहो धिगिति चाब्रुवन्। द्रोणोऽपि शस्त्राण्युत्सृज्य परमं सांख्यमास्थितः॥
en: They bewailed piteously and they cried alas and oh and said fie. Meanwhile Drona, having laid aside his weapons, was peacefully seated on his car.

sa: यथा चन्द्रोदयोद्भूतः क्षुभितः सागरोऽभवत्। तथा चन्द्रोदयोद्भूतः स बभूव बलार्णवः॥
en: Just as the ocean swells in consequence of the rising of the moon so that ocean of troops swelled at the rising of the moon.

sa: ततस्ते पर्यवर्तन्त सर्वे द्रोणरथं प्रति॥ भयात् पतगराजस्य गर्तानीव महोरगाः।
en: Thereafter terrified all of them proceeded towards the car of Drona like mighty snakes entering their holes from fear of the king of birds (Garuda).

sa: प्रातिपेयस्तु संक्रुद्धः शक्तिं भीमस्य वक्षसि॥ निचखान महाबाहुः पुरंदर इवाशनिम्।
en: Like Purandara hurling the thunder bolt, the mighty arrmed son of Partha. (i.e., Valhika), smitten with ire, struck Bhima on the chest with an arrow.

sa: यथा चन्द्रोदयोद्भूतः क्षुभितः सागरोऽभवत्। तथा चन्द्रोदयोद्भूतः स बभूव बलार्णवः॥
en: Just as the ocean swells in consequence of the rising of the moon so that ocean of troops swelled at the rising of the moon.

sa: ब्रूयाद् एवं गाण्डीवमन्यस्मै देयमित्युत। वध्योऽस्य स पुमाँल्लोके त्वया चोक्तोऽयमीदृशम्॥५०
en: Whoever in this world tells him, 'Give your Gandiva to anotehr,' would be slain by him. And even these words you addressed him just now.

sa: विव्याध समरे द्रोणं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। द्रोणश्चापि महाराज शरैर्विव्याध पार्षतम्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna began to pierce Drona in battle; Drona also, O mighty monarch, pierced the son of Prisata with numerous shafts in battle.

sa: सप्तत्या सारथिं विद्ध्वा तुरङ्गांश्चत्रिस्त्रिभिः। ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छेद माधवस्य रथे स्थितम्॥
en: Piercing the charioteer of him of Madhu's race with seventy arrows and the horses with three arrows each, cut-off his standard with a single arrows.

sa: धिक्कृतः पार्षतस्तं तु सर्वभूतैः परामृशत्। तस्य मूर्धानमालम्ब्य गतसत्त्वस्य देहिनः॥
en: Prisata's meanwhile, though all creatures cried fie on him, yet casting his eyes on the lifeless Drona's head, began to drag it (by the hair.)

sa: नभोऽभवत् तद् दुष्प्रेक्ष्यमुल्काभिरिव संवृतम्। ततः शस्रान्धकारं तत् कौरवैः समुदीरितम्॥
en: The sky became incapable of being looked at, as if covered with flashing meteors. Thereupon the darkness that the Kauravas had created with their arrows.

sa: तद् वचः सर्वधर्मज्ञा धार्मिकस्य विशाम्पते। अरोचयन्त सैन्यानि तथा चान्योन्यमब्रुवन्॥
en: Hearing these word of the virtuous Arjuna, the pious warriors of the Kuru army agreed to follow up the former's suggestion and addressing one another.

sa: स शङ्कमानस्तन्मिथ्या धर्मराजमपृच्छत। हतं वाप्यहतं वाऽऽजौ त्वां पिता पुत्रवत्सलः॥
en: Your father affectionate to his son then doubting the veracity of Bhima's words, questioned very virtuous king Yudhishthira, whether you were really slain or not.

sa: रुधिरेण परिक्किन्नः कृतवर्मा त्वराजत॥ वर्षेण केदिता राजन् यथा गैरिकपर्वतः।
en: even O king, Kritavarman, being thus smeared with blood, blazed forth like a red-chalk mountain streaked (by the streams of liquefied red-chalk) by a shower.

sa: यत् कर्तव्यं मनुष्येण व्यवसायवता सदा। तत् कार्यमविशङ्केन सिद्धिदैवे प्रतिष्ठिता॥
en: That, which a person having perseverance ought to do, should be performed by him in a fearless spirit, (though of course) success depends upon fate.

sa: संजय उवाच दुपदस्यात्मजान् दृष्ट्वा कुन्तिभोजसुतांस्तथा। द्रोणपुत्रेण निहतान् राक्षसांश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing that the sons of Drupada and those of Kuntibhoja as well as thousands of Rakshasas were destroyed by the son of Drona.

sa: आचार्यं ये च तेऽरक्षन् दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः। द्रौणिकर्णकृपास्तात ते वाकुर्वन् किमाहवे॥
en: What also did they do in battle, O sire, viz., Drona's son and Karna and Kripa and others headed by Duryodhana that protected the preceptor.

sa: ततोद्रोणं शिने:पौत्रो राजन् विव्याध पत्रिणा। दक्षिणं भुजमासाद्य पीडयन् भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thereafter ( king, Sini's grandson pierced Drona on his right arin with many winged shafts. Thus, O foremost of the Bharatas, Drona was greatly afflicted,

sa: अद्य कर्णस्य चक्राङ्गाः क्रव्यदाश्च पृथग्विधाः॥ शरैश्छिन्नानि गात्राणि विहरिष्यन्ति केशव।
en: O Keshava, today, vulture and other birds of prey will roam about the body of Karna, cut into pieces with the shafts of my arrows.

sa: घटोत्कचे व्यंसितां तु दृष्ट्वा तां शिनिपुङ्गव। मृत्योरास्यान्तरान्मुक्तं पश्याम्यद्य धनंजयम्॥
en: Beholding that dart therefore rendered fruitless through Ghatotkacha, O foremost of the Shinis, I consider Phalguna to be almost saved from the jaws of Death.

sa: क्षणेन च रथस्तस्य सध्वजः सहसारथिः। नादृश्यत महाराज पार्षतस्य शरैश्चितः॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, covered with the arrows the car of Prisata's son; soon did the car of Dushasana, its standard and charioteer became invisible.

sa: स कथं कौरवेयेण समरेष्वनिवारितः। निगृह्य भूरिश्रवसा बलाद् भुवि निपातितः॥
en: How was it then that Satyaki checked and humiliated by the scion of the Kurus namely Bhurisravas, was brought down on the ground with force.

sa: सुतस्तवाब्रवीद् राजन् सारथिं रथिनां वरः। यत्रैष शब्दस्तत्राश्वांश्चोदयेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: Your son that foremost of car-warrior, O king, addressing his charioteer thus repeatedly spoke-"Drive, drive the steeds to the spot whence this tumult is proceeding.”

sa: अजयद् राजपुत्रांस्तान् भ्राजमानान् महारणे। एकः पञ्चाशतं शत्रून् सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: But the unsupported Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled, conquered his fifth antagonists, all princes of the Trigartta race looking very beautiful in battle.

sa: अथ सूर्योऽतिचक्राम तेषां संवदतां तथा। अथर्षिश्चोदयामास पानमन्नं तथैव च॥
en: While they were thus conversing with each other, the sun was over the meridian. The Rishi ordered the king to bring him food and drink.

sa: यथा शान्तनुना गुप्ता राज्ञा चित्राङ्गदेन च। भीष्मवीर्योपगूढेन पित्रा तव च पार्थिव॥ भवदुद्वीक्षणाच्चैव पाण्डुना पृथिवीक्षिता। तथा दुर्योधनेनापि राज्ञा सुपरिपालताः॥
en: We were well-protected and ruled by king Duryodhana even as we had been ruled by king Shantanu, or by Chitrangada, or by your father, O monarch, who was protected by the prowess of Bhishma, or by Pandu, that ruler of Earth, who was overlooked by you in all is deeds.

sa: तमनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवता मुनिसत्तम। त्वदधीना वयं सर्वे कृष्णस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: 0 best of ascetics, I wish to have your permission. We are all, O Rishi, at your disposal, and at that of the great Krishna.

sa: भेरीमृदङ्गशब्दांश्च तन्त्रीशब्दांश्च पुष्कलान्। निषेविष्यन्ति वै मन्दा मांसभक्षाः कथं नराः॥
en: How will those foolish men who live upon meat succeed in listening to the sweet music of celestial drums and cymbals and lyres and harps?

sa: तान् पूजयस्व सततं दानेन परिचर्यया। यदीच्छसि महीं भोक्तुमिमां सागरमेखलाम्॥
en: Do you always adore them with gifts and obedient services, if, indeed, you desire to enjoy the sovereignty of the whole Earth encircled by seas.

sa: स्वमांसं परमांसेन यो वर्धयितुमिच्छति। नारदः प्राह धर्मात्मा नियतं सोऽवसीदति॥
en: The virtuous Narada has said that that man who wishes to multiply his own flesh by eating the flesh of other creatures, meet with disaster.

sa: ब्रह्मैव समिधस्तस्य ब्रह्माग्निर्ब्रह्मसम्भवः। आपो ब्रह्म गुरुर्बह्म स ब्रह्मणि समाहितः॥
en: Brahma is his fuel; Brahma is his fire; Brahma is his origin; Brahma is his water; Brahma is his preceptor; he is immerged in Brahma.

sa: ऋषयो देहसम्भूतास्तस्य लोकाश्च शाश्वताः। पितामहगृहं साक्षात् सर्वदेवगृहं च सः॥
en: From his body have originated the Rishis as also all the eternal worlds. He is the abode of the Grandfather and of all the gods.

sa: दर्शनात् स्पर्शनात् पानात् तथा गङ्गेति कीर्तनात्। पुनात्यपुण्याम् पुरुषाच्छतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: By seeing touching and drinking the waters of Ganga, or by praising them, hundreds and thousands of sinful men become purged of all their sins.

sa: लोभाद् वा बुद्धिमोहाद् वा बलवीर्यार्थमेव च। संसर्गादथ पापानामधर्मरुचिता नृणाम्॥
en: Through cupidity or stupefaction of sense, for the sake of strength and energy, or through association with the sinful, men show tendency for committing sin.

sa: हतपुत्रस्य संग्रामे दानानि ददतः सदा। ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिमित्राणां भ्रातॄणां स्वजनस्य च॥
en: Having lost all his children in battle, he had made many gifts in honour of his kinsmen, relatives, and friends, his brothers and own people.

sa: अहिंसा सर्वधर्माणामिति वृद्धानुशासनम्। यदहिस्रं भवेत् कर्म तत् कार्यमिति विद्महे॥
en: Abstention from cruelty is the foremost of all duties. This is the teaching of the elders. We know that no crucl action should be donc.

sa: मातरं चाविदूरस्थां शिष्यवत् प्रणतां स्थिताम्। कुन्तीं ददर्श धर्मात्मा शिष्टाचारसमन्विताम्॥
en: The righteous souled monarch beheld also his mother, Kunti, seated not much remote from that place, like a disciple with bent head, gifted with humility.

sa: विवाहांश्चैव कुर्वीत पुत्रानुत्पादयेत च। पुत्रलाभो हि कौरव्य सर्वलाभाद् विशिष्यते॥
en: One should marry and procreate offspring upon one's married wives. Of all acquistions, O son of Kuru's race, that of sons is considered the foremost.

sa: दुश्चरा द्वादशसमा हत्वा पितरमद्य वै। ममेह सुनृशंसस्य संवीतस्यास्य चर्मणा॥
en: Having killed my own father, I should, suffering every sort of misery, wonder over the Earth, cruel that I am, covering myself with his skin.

sa: अथवा मासमेकं वै सर्व मांसान्यभक्षयन्। अतीत्य सर्वदुःखानि सुखं जीवेन्निरामयः॥
en: He who abstains for the whole month of Kartika from meat of every kind, gets over all sorts of woe and lives in complete happiness.

sa: स हि तादृग्गुणस्तेन तुल्योऽध्ययनजन्मना। अपत्येषु तथा वृत्ते समस्तेनैव धीमता॥
en: This other man I want is equal to him in virtues, study and birth. As for children and conduct, this other reassembles the intelligent Sharmin.

sa: नाथवन्तश्च भवता पाण्डवा मधुसूदन। भवन्तं प्लमासाद्य तीर्णाः स्म कुरुसागरम्॥
en: O destroyer of Madhu, on you the Pandavas have got a powerful protector having obtained you for our raft we have crossed the Kuru ocean.

sa: आदित्यो वरुणो विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा सोमो हुताशनः। शूलपाणिश्च भगवान् प्रतिनन्दन्ति भूमिदम्॥
en: The Sun, Varuna, Vishnu, Brahmana, the Moon, the FireGod and the illustrious and tridentbearing Mahadeva, all praise the man who makes a gift of earth.

sa: सुदुष्कृतं कृतवती कुन्ती पुत्रानपश्यती। राज्यश्रियं परित्यज्य वनं सा समरोचयत्॥
en: Difficult is the feat that Kunti has performed by separating herself from her sons. Alas, renouncing royal prosperity, she choose a life in the forest.

sa: गान्धार्या सह नार्यस्तु सहिताः समुपाविशन्। पौरजानपदश्चापि जनः सर्वो यथावयः॥
en: The royal ladies sat with Gandhari in a secluded spot. All the citizens and the inhabitants of the provinces ranged themselves according to their years.

sa: राजानं च समासाद्य धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्। चोदयिष्यामि धर्मज्ञ गमनार्थं तवानघ।॥
en: Going to king Yudhishthira of righteous soul, I shall, O sinless one, urge him to dismiss you, O you who are conversant with every duty.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं व्यासः परमधर्मवित्। पुत्रायाकथयत् सर्वं तत्त्वेन भरतर्षभ॥
en: Having heard these words of his son, O chief of Bharata's race, Vyasa, the foremost of all persons knowing duties, said as follows to him.

sa: स पितुर्विक्रियां दृष्ट्वा राज्यान्निरसनं च तत्। नियतो वर्तयामास प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया।॥ ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवादी च शुचिः शमदमान्वितः। प्रजास्तं चान्वरज्यन्त धर्मनित्यं मनस्विनम्॥
en: Seeing the reverses of his father and his expulsion from the empire he was ever busy with encompassing the well-being of the people, being devoted to Brahman, speaking the truth, practising purity and controlling his senses and thoughts. And the subjects were well-pleased with that grcat one constant in virtue.

sa: तडागे यस्य गावस्तु पिबन्ति तृषिता जलम्। मृगपक्षिमनुष्याच सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: That man in whose tank kine satisfy their thirst as also other animals and birds, and human being, gains the merits of of a horsesacrifice.

sa: एतं दोषं पुरा दृष्ट्वा भार्गवश्च्यवनस्तदा। आगामिनं महाबुद्धिः स्ववंशे मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: Gifted with great intelligence, Chyavana of Bhrigu's race, that best of ascetics, saw (with his spiritual eye) the stain that would affect his own race.

sa: दोग्ध्री वासांसि रत्नानि पशून् व्रीहियवांस्तथा। भूमिदः सर्वभूतेषु शाश्वतीरेधते समाः॥
en: It gives dresses and vestments, jewels and gems, animals, paddy, and barley. Amongst all creatures, the giver of earth grows rich for ever and ever.

sa: अत्यर्थं बलवानूष्मा शरीरे परिकोपितः। भिनत्ति जीवस्थानानि मर्माणि विद्धि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Know truly that excited all over the body, the heat becomes very strong, and pierces every vital part where life may be said to live.

sa: सौबलेयी च गान्धारी पुत्रशोकमपास्य तम्॥ सदैव प्रीतिमत्यासीत् तनयेषु निजेष्विव।
en: Subala's daughter, Gandhari, renouncing all sorrow for her (slain) children, began to show great love for the Pandavas as if they were her own children.

sa: कुले महति जातासि क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम्। मा शुचश्चपलाक्षं त्वं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणे॥
en: You are born in a high family of great Kshatriyas. Do not grieve, O you of restless glances, O girl of eyes like lotus petals!

sa: गान्धारी चैव धर्मज्ञा कुन्त्या सह मनस्विनी। वधूभिरुपचारेण पूजिताभुङ्क्त भारत॥
en: Gandhari knowing every duty, as also the highly intelligent Kunti, adored with offers of various articles by their daughters-in-law, then took some food, O Bharata.

sa: सर्वान्नानार्थयुक्तांश्च सर्वान् प्रत्यक्षहेतुकान्। यतः परं न विद्यते ततोऽभ्यासे भविष्यति॥
en: Indeed, one should comprehend various objects of various significancies, and all objects of direct perception. Then will come, from practice, that above which nothing cxists.

sa: प्रयोजनं च निर्वृत्तं जीवितस्य ममानघ। उग्रं तपः समास्थास्ये त्वमनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: O sinless one, I have gained the object of my life. I now wish to practice the austerest of penances. You should grant me permission.

sa: कामं गच्छन्तु मे सर्वे भ्रातरोऽनुचरास्तथा। भवन्तमहमन्विष्ये मातरौ च यतव्रतः॥
en: Let all my brothers and followers go as they like. With steadfast vows I shall wait upon you and upon these two mothers of mine.'

sa: समर्था धारणे चापि रुद्रतेजःप्रधर्षिता। नाशकत् तं तदा गर्भ संधारयितुमोजसा॥
en: Capable of bearing that seed, yet oppressed by the power of Rudra, she could not hold that seed longer on account of its burning energy.

sa: समाहृते च संग्रामात् पार्थे संशप्तकैस्तदा॥ पर्यवार्यत संक्रुद्धैः स द्रोणादिभिराहवे।
en: When his father Arjuna was withdrawn from the main body by the Samsaptakas, Abhimanyu was surrounded by the enraged Kaurava-heroes headed by Drona in battle.

sa: कच्चिन्न निकृतो बालो द्रोणकर्णकृपादिभिः॥ धरण्यां निहतः शेते तन्ममाचक्ष्व केशव।
en: I hope that boy does not lie on the field, killed deceitfully by Drona and Karna and Kripa and others? Do you teli me this.

sa: स्त्रीणां तु पतिदायाद्यमुपभोगफलं स्मृतम्। नापहारं स्त्रियः कुर्युः पतिवित्तात् कथंचन॥
en: Upon the death of the childless husband, the wife shall enjoy all his riches. The wife should never take any portion of her husband's riches.

sa: आत्मानमालोकयति मनसा प्रहसन्निव। तदेवमाश्रयं कृत्वा मोक्ष याति ततो मयि॥
en: He sees the Soul with his mind, siniling as it were at the time. Depending upon that Brahma; he then attains to Liberation in me.

sa: वने स मुनिभिः सर्वैः पूज्यमानो महातपाः। त्वगस्थिमात्रशेषः स षण्मासानभवन्नृपः॥
en: Engaged in severe penances, he was adored by all the ascetics in the forest. In six months the king was reduced to only a skeleton.

sa: ततः पार्थं समासाद्य पतङ्ग इव पावकम्। पञ्चत्वमगमत् सौतिर्द्वितीयेऽहनि दारुणः॥
en: The Suta's son Karna, though a dreadful warrior, encountering Partha, came to his end on the second day, like an insect encountering a burning fire.

sa: एतत् ते भरतश्रेष्ठ मया कात्स्न्येन कीर्तितम्। छत्रोपानहदानस्य फलं भरतसत्तम॥
en: O foremost one of Bharata's race. I have thus recited to you, in full the merits of giving away shoes and umbrellas at religious ceremonies.

sa: गान्धारी तु जलाहारी कुन्ती मासोपवासिनी। संजयः षष्ठभुक्तेन वर्तयामास भारत॥
en: Gandhari lived on water alone, while Kunti took a little food a intervals of month. Sanjaya, O Bharata, lived, eating a little every sixth day.

sa: वक्त्राच्छशाङ्कसदृशाद् वाणी संस्कारभूषणा। वीडिता सा तु तद्वाक्यमुक्त्वा परवशा तदा॥
en: Subject to the influence of another, she gave vent to these words, but became rather ashamed for uttering them. Hearing her, Purandara became highly disspirited.

sa: ततः स्वाचरणो विप्रः सम्मतोऽर्थविशारदः। साम्बाख्यो बढ्चो राजन् वक्तुं समुपचक्रमे॥
en: That learned Brahinana, of good conduct, chosen by unanimous consent, conversant with all subjects, master of all the Rics, and named Samba, tried to speak.

sa: सन्निमध्येन्द्रियग्राममासीत् काष्ठोपमस्तदा। गान्धारी च महाभागा जननी च पृथा तव॥
en: Governing all the senses, he remained like a post of wood. The highly blessed Gandhari, and your mother Pritha top, remained in the same attitude.

sa: ब्राह्मोवाच समोऽहं सर्वभूतानामधर्मं नेह रोचये। हन्यतां तारकः क्षिप्रं सुरर्षिगणबाधिता॥
en: Brahman said I treat all creatures equally, I cannot however, approve of sin, Let Taraka, that enemy of the celestials and Rishis, be speedily destroyed.

sa: अग्निर्ब्रह्मा पशुपतिः शर्वो रुद्रः प्रजापतिः। अग्नेरपत्यमेतद् वै सुवर्णमिति धारणा॥
en: Agni is Brahman. He is Pashupati. He is Sarva. He is Rudra. He is Prajapati. It is wellknown that gold is the offspring of Agni.

sa: पूताभिश्च तथैवाद्भिः सदा दैवततर्पणम्। भावेन नियतः कुर्वन् ब्रह्मचारी प्रशस्यते॥
en: He should also satisfy the celestials with oblations of pure water, his mind being controlled the while, Such a Brahmacharin is worthy of being lauded.

sa: एवं त्वया कुरुश्रेष्ठ वर्तितव्यं प्रजाहितम्। उभयोर्लोकयोस्तात प्राप्तये नित्यमेव हि॥
en: O foremost one of Kurus' race, it is thus that you should always seek the well-being of your subjects for attaining to both the worlds.

sa: सर्वे प्रजानां पतयः सर्वे चातितपस्विनः। त्वत्प्रसादादिमं लोकं तारयिष्यन्ति साम्प्रतम्॥
en: Let all of them become progenitors of offspring. Let all of them become endued with penances. Through your favour, let all these rescue the world.

sa: स तु वहिर्महाज्वालो दग्ध्वा सर्वमशेषतः। विष्णो:समीप आगम्य पादौ शिष्यवदस्पृशत्॥
en: That fire of powerful flames, having consumed everything without living a residue, at last returned to Vishnu and touched his feet like a docile disciple.

sa: भृशं भीतास्ततः शान्तिं चक्रुः स्वस्त्ययनानि च। ऋषयः सर्वभूतानामात्मनश्च हितैषिणः॥
en: The great Rishis, stricken with fear and desirous of doing good to themselves and the universe, performed the usual usual rites of propitiation and peace.

sa: तमेवंवादिनं शक्रं शुश्राव विपुलो मुनिः। गुरुपल्ल्याः शरीरस्थो ददर्श त्रिदशाधिपम्॥
en: These words that Indra spoke were heard by the ascetic Vipula. Remaining within the body of his preceptor's wife, he saw everything that took place.

sa: प्रेतलोकगता ह्येते नरके पापकर्मिणः। पच्यन्ते वै यथा मीना: पूयशोणितभोजनाः॥
en: These men of sinful conduct when they go to the region of the dead rot in hell like worms which live upon puss and blood.

sa: उत्तरीयैः करैश्चापि संच्छाद्य वदनानि ते। रुरुदुः शोकसंतप्ता मुहूर्तं पितृमातृवत्॥
en: Covering their faces with their hands and upper garments, all those men, burning with grief, wept for a while as father sand mothers would weep.

sa: इत्युक्तास्तेन ते सर्वे पौरजानपदा जनाः। नोचुर्वाष्पकला: किंचिद् वीक्षांचक्रुः परस्परम्॥
en: Thus addressed by the old king, all those citizens and dwellers of the provinces, filled with icars, said nothing but only looked at one another.

sa: उत्थाय तु यथाकालमुत्तरा यदुनन्दनम्। अभ्यवादयत प्रीता सह पुत्रेण भारत॥
en: Uttara, rising up at the proper time, with a pleased heart and bearing her child in her arms, reverentially saluted the delighter of the Yadus.

sa: स भवान् पुरुषव्याघ्र ब्रह्मभूतः सनातनः। यदर्थमनुशिष्टाः स्मो गिरिपृष्ठे महात्मना॥
en: Tliat Foremost of all Beings, of whom the great Shankara spoke to us on that mountain, are You. You are at one with Eternal Brahma.

sa: तदद्भुतमचिन्त्यं च दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मिताऽभवन्। शङ्करस्योमया साधू संवादं त्वत्कथाश्रयम्॥
en: Seeing that wonderful and inconceivable spectacle, they become filled with surprise. They had heard the discourse, too, between Shankara and Uma with the same feelings.

sa: न्यायेनैवाप्तमन्नं तु नरो हर्षसमन्वितः। द्विजेभ्यो वेदवृद्धेभ्यो दत्त्वा पापात् प्रमुच्यते॥
en: A person by cheerfully making gifts of food acquired by fair means to Brahmans pereminent for Vedic learning, becomes purged off of all his sins.

sa: प्रत्याख्याने च दाने च सुखदुःखे प्रियाप्रिये। आत्मौपम्येन पुरुषः प्रमाणमधिगच्छति॥
en: In refusing and giving, in weal and woe, in the agrecable and the disagreeable, one should judge of their effects by considering his own self.

sa: प्रतियाटुं न शक्यो हि मानुषैरेष संयुगे। विहीनैः पुरुषव्याघ्र सत्त्वशक्तिबलादिभिः॥
en: How incapable then must human beings be of fighting against that Krishna, human beings who, O foremost of men, are shorn of strength and power.

sa: तेऽब्रुवज्ञातुमिच्छामः कतमोऽत्र युधिष्ठिरः। भीमार्जुनौ यमौ चैव द्रौपदी च यशस्विनी॥
en: They said, 'We wish to know who amongst these is Yudhishthira, who are Bhima and Arjuna, who the twins, and who is the illustrious Draupadi?'

sa: तस्मात् कुन्तीसुत ज्ञातीन् नेह शोचितुमर्हसि। व्यपेतमन्युर्नित्यं त्वं भव कौरवनन्दन॥
en: For these reasons, O son of Kunti, you should not grieve for your (slain) kinsfolk. Be always free, O delighter of the Kurus, from grief.

sa: परं परं तथैवाहुश्चातुराश्रम्यमेव तत्। यथोक्ता नियमास्तेषां सर्वं कार्यं बुभूषता॥
en: The same rule of merit holds good regarding the four modes of life also viz., every succeeding one is superior to the one preceding it.

sa: बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि चैतानि तथा कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च। सम्भूतानीह युगपन्मनसा सह पार्थिव॥
en: The first five of those form the organs of knowledge, and the last five the organs of action. All these, with mind, simultaneously, O king.

sa: तेऽतिष्ठन् ध्यानमालम्ब्य मौनमास्थाय निश्चलाः। त्यक्तहाराः पवनपा दिव्यं वर्षशतं द्विजाः॥
en: Governing speech, they remained immovable, engaged in contemplation. Having abstained from food, they lived upon air alone, and remained thus for a thousand divine years.

sa: बस्तिमूलं गुदं चैव पावकं समुपाश्रितः। वहन्मूत्रं पुरीषं चाप्यपान: परिवर्तते॥
en: The vital air called Apana, by the help of the heat that is in the urethra, abdomen and intestines, moves, carrying out urine and excreta.

sa: आत्मा क्षेत्रज्ञ इत्युक्तः संयुक्तः प्राकृतैर्गुणैः। तैरेव तु विनिर्मुक्तः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः॥
en: When the Soul is endued with ordinary attributes, it is called Kshetrajna. When freed from those attributes, attributes, it is designated Paramatman or Supreme Self.

sa: यथेह यत् कृतं शुभं विपाप्मभिः कृतात्मभिः। तदाप्नुवन्ति मानवास्तथा विशुद्धयोनयः॥
en: Men of pure deeds and purified souls and pure birth acquire in the next world fruits commensurate with their own righteous deeds in this life.

sa: मनो मतिरहंकारस्तन्मात्राणीन्द्रियाणि च। ब्रूहि चैषां भवेच्छक कोऽन्योऽस्ति परमं शिवात्।।
en: Tell me, O Shakra, who clse than Shiva could create Mind, Understanding, Ego, the subtile elements and the senses? Who is there higher than Shiva?

sa: दुर्बलश्च यथा राजन् स्रोतसा ह्रियते नरः। बलहीनस्तथा योगो विषयैर्व्हियतेऽवशः॥
en: As a weak man, O king, is carried away by a current, so is a weak Yogin helplessly carried away by objects of the senses.

sa: तथा शतमुखो नाम धात्रा सृष्टो महासुरः॥ येन वर्षशतं साग्रमात्ममांसैर्हतोऽनलः।
en: Another great Asura, named Shatamukha, was created by Brahman. For a hundred years he poured on the sacrificial fire the flesh of his own body.

sa: अहोरात्रमये लोके जरारूपेण संसरन्। मृत्युर॑सति भूतानि पवनं पन्नगो यथा॥
en: Like a snake devouring air, Death walks in this world made up of days and nights in the form of Decrepitude and devours all ceatures.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततो विकृतवेषौ द्वौ पुरुषौ समुपस्थितौ। गृहीत्वान्योन्यमावेष्ट्य कुचैलावूचतुर्वचः॥
en: Bhishma continued 'At this time two very ugly persons came there. Each had his arm upon the other's shoulder; both were ill-dressed. They said these

sa: अश्वमेधसहस्रं च सत्यं च तुलया धृतम्। अश्वमेधसहस्राद्धि सत्यमेव विशिष्यते॥
en: On one occasion a thousand Horsesacrifices and Truth were weighed against each other and in the balance. Truth proved heavier than a thousand Horse-sacrifices. as

sa: एते त्रयोदशाकाराः पृथक् सत्यैकलक्षणाः। भजन्ते सत्यमेवेह बृंहयन्ते च भारत॥
en: These thirteen qualities, though seemingly different, have but one and the same shape, namely Truth. All these, O Bharata, hold up truth and strengthen it.

sa: पराशर उवाच राजन्नेतद् भवेद् ग्राह्यमपकृष्टेन जन्मना। महात्मनां समुत्पत्तिस्तपसा भावितात्मनाम्॥
en: O king, that status of great persons who succeeded in purifying their souls by penances could not be regarded as affected by their low births.

sa: अबुद्धिरज्ञानकृता अबुद्ध्या कृष्यते मनः। दुष्टस्य मनसः पञ्च सम्प्रदुष्यन्ति मानसाः॥
en: Ignorance produces Delusion. Delusion possesses the mind. When the mind becomes impure, the five senses which have the mind for their refuge becomed corrupted also.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पितामह महाप्राज्ञ युधि सत्यपराक्रम। श्रोतुमिच्छामि कात्स्येन कृष्णमव्ययमीश्वरम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, O you of great wisdom and invincible prowess in battle, I wish to hear fully of Krishna who is immutable omnipotent.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिगतं रूपं कथं धारितवान् प्रभुः। केन कार्यनिसर्गेण तमाख्याहि महाबल॥
en: Why did that powerful one assume the form of an animal, and that for performing what particular act? Tell me all this, O mighty warrior.

sa: तस्य पुत्रा महात्मानो ब्रह्मवंशविवर्धनाः। तपस्विनो ब्रह्मविदो गोत्रकार एव च॥
en: His sons became great progenitors of many race of Brahmanas who were given to austere penances, learned in the Vedas, and founders of many clans.

sa: कथं देवर्षिरुशना सदा काव्यो महामतिः। असुराणां प्रियकरः सुराणामप्रिये रतः॥
en: Why was the celestial Rishi, the great Ushanas, called also Kavi, engaged in doing what was agreeable to the Asuras and disagreeable to the gods.

sa: तपस्विनां धर्मवतां विदुषां चोपसेवनात्। प्राप्स्यसे विपुलां बुद्धि तथा श्रेयोऽभिपत्स्यसे॥
en: You are sure to acquire great intelligence, as also what is for your highest good by seeing virtuous and learned persons endued with ascetic merit.

sa: एषा पृथक् समस्तानां श्रूयते मधुरस्वरः। पुष्पसम्मोदने काले वाशतां सुमनोहरम्॥
en: When you put forth your blossoms, the sweet notes of all these dwellers of your branches are heard separately when they sing their melodious songs.

sa: अग्नीषोमाविदं सर्वमिति यश्चानुपश्यति। न च संस्पृश्यते भावैरद्भुतैर्मुक्त एव सः॥
en: One, who sees all the objects in the form of Fire and Soma, he is never affected by wonderful pleasures and is considered as liberated.

sa: यदर्थं धर्मसंसर्गः कर्मणां च फलोदयः। तमनाश्वासिकं मोहं विनाशि चलमध्रुवम्॥
en: He also described that Delusion which beget the practice of religion, and acts, and their fruits, and which is highly untrustworthy, destructible, unsteady, and uncertain.

sa: रक्षिता त्वद्गुणैरेषा पतिव्रतगुणैस्तथा। अधृष्या यदियं ब्रूयात् तथा तन्नान्यथा भवेत्॥
en: She has been saved from contamination by your virtue and by her own chastity. There can be nothing against what this proud lady will say.

sa: जीवन्तमपि चैवैनं भरणे रक्षणे तथा। असमाप्ते परित्यज्य पश्चादपि मरिष्यसि॥
en: In the very life-time of your relatives and before own duty is completed of feeding and protecting them, you may yourself die and leave them.

sa: कामात् क्रोधाद् भयाल्लोभाद् दैन्याच्यानार्यकात् तथा। ह्रीतोऽनुक्रोशतो मानान्न वक्ष्यामि कथंचन॥
en: I shall not tell you anything, actuated by desire or anger or fear or cupidity or abjectness or deceipt or shame or mercy or pride.

sa: यैराविष्टानि भूतानि अहन्यहनि पार्थिव। अन्योन्यं स्पृहयन्त्येते अन्योन्यस्य हिते रताः॥ अन्योन्यमतिवर्तन्ते अन्योन्यस्पर्धिनस्तथा। ते वध्यमाना ह्यन्योन्यं गुणैर्हारिभरव्ययैः॥ इहैव परिवर्तन्ते तिर्यग्योनिप्रवेशिनः।
en: All creatures, 0 king, continually permeated by these five, seek one another's companionship, become subservient to one another, and challenging one another, get over one another; and actuated by those immutable and seductive principles, creatures kill one another and rove in this world, entering into numerous intermediate orders of Being.

sa: क्रव्याट्य इव भूतानमदान्तेभ्यः सदाभयम्। तेषां विप्रतिषेधार्थं राजा सृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: Like tigers and other carnivorous animals, persons shorn of self-control always strike all creatures with fear. For controlling these men, the Self-create (Brahma) created kings.

sa: यथाशीला हि राजानः सर्वान् विषयवासिनः। श्रेयसा योजयत्याशु श्रेयसि प्रत्युपस्थिते॥
en: Kings endued with such a disposition, secure the prosperity of those who live in their kingdoms when prosperity is on the point of leaving them.

sa: यत्र राजा च राज्ञश्च पुरुषाः प्रत्यनन्तराः। कुटुम्बिनामग्रभुजस्त्यजेत् तद् राष्ट्रमात्मवान्।॥
en: The pious man should leave that kingdom where the king and the king's officers exercise equal authority and where people eat before feeding their relatives.

sa: जगद् दग्ध्वामितबलः केवलां जगतीं ततः। अम्भसा बलिना क्षिप्रमापूरयति सर्वशः॥
en: Having burnt everything on the face of the Earth, Rudra of incomparable might, then quickly fills the bare Earth with Water, possessed of great force.

sa: प्रह्लाद उवाच आर्जवेनाप्रमादेन प्रसादेनात्मवत्तया। वृद्धशुश्रषया शक्र पुरुषो लभते महत्॥
en: Prahlada said 'By simplicity, by carefulness, by purifying the soul, by controlling the passions, and by waiting upon elders, O Shakra, a person acquires liberation.

sa: जम्बुक उवाच दारुणो मर्त्यलोकोऽयं सर्वप्राणिविनाशनः। इष्टबन्धुवियोगश्च तथेहाल्पं च जीवितम्॥
en: The jackal said Alas, dreadful is this world of mortals! Here no creature can escape. Every creature's life is short. Beloved friends are always going.

sa: ते चातिनिपुणा वैद्याः कुशलाः सम्भृतौषधाः। व्याधिभिः परिकृष्यन्ते मृगा व्याधैरिवार्दिताः॥
en: Even physicians, who are well-skilled and expert in their science and well-equipt with excellent medicines, are themselves attacked by disease like animals assailed by hunters.

sa: शुचौ वाभ्यर्थिते देशे त्रिदशाः प्रायशः स्थिताः॥ लक्ष्मीसहितमासीनं मघवन्तं दिदृक्षवः॥
en: All the gods, (hearing the news) gathered together in a pure and desirable spot and waited there for seeing Maghavat seated with Lakshmi beside him.

sa: ववौ सुखः शिवो वायु नागन्धवहः शुचिः। सर्वर्तुकुसुमोपेताः पुष्पवन्तो द्रुमास्तथा॥
en: A pure and auspicious air carrying various sorts of perfumes, blew there. The trees that stood there were adorned with the flowers of all seasons.

sa: ज्वरेण मोहितो वृत्रः कथितस्ते जनाधिप। निहतो वासवेनेह वज्रेणेति तदानघ।।२।
en: You have said, O king, that Vritra was Stupefied by Fever, and that then, O sinless one, he was killed by Vasava with the thunderboli.

sa: एता द्वादशसाहस्री युगाख्यां कवयो विदुः। सहस्रपरिवर्तं तद् ब्राह्यं दिवसमुच्यते॥
en: The learned say that these twelve thousand celestial years from what is celled a cycle. A thousand such cycles form a single day of Brahman.

sa: शुकस्तु मारुतादूर्ध्वं गति कृत्वान्तरिक्षगाम्॥ दर्शयित्वा प्रभावं स्वं ब्रह्मभूतोऽभवत् तदा।
en: Meanwhile Shuka, passing through thai region of the sky which is above the region of the wind, showed his Yoga-power and identified himself with Brahma.

sa: मनस्तथैवाहंकारे प्रतिष्ठाप्य नराधिप। अहंकार तथा बुद्धौ बुद्धिं च प्रकृतावपि॥
en: The mind should then be fixed on Consciousness, O king; Consciousness should next be fixed on Intelligence, and Buddhi should then be fixed on Nature.

sa: ततो मन्दाकिनीतीरे क्रीडन्तोऽप्सरसां गणाः॥ आसाद्य तमृषि सर्वाः सम्भ्रान्ता गतचेतसः।
en: Seeing the Rishi seated there, the Apsaras who were sporting on the banks of the celestial river Mandakini, became all moved with shame and dispirited.

sa: दिव्यमष्टशलाकं तु सौवर्णं परमर्द्धिमत्। छत्रं देवावृधो दत्त्वा सराष्ट्रोऽभ्यपतद् दिवम्॥
en: Having given away a very beautiful and costly umbrella, with eight golden ribs, King Devavriddha proceeded to heaven with all the denizens of his kingdom.

sa: चिरकारी पितरं दृष्ट्वा परमदुः शस्त्रं त्यक्त्वा ततो मूर्धा प्रसादायोपचक्रमे॥
en: Seeing his father return to their house, the son Chirakarin, laden with grief, cast away the weapon and bowing his head began to pacify Gautama.

sa: एतेन केवलं याति त्यक्त्वा देहमसाक्षिकम्। कालेन महता राजश्रुतिरेषां सनातनी॥
en: It is by this means that he acquires, after many years, Liberation after renouncing this inanimate body. Even this is what the eternal Shruti says.

sa: षण्णामात्मनि बुद्धौ च जितायां प्रभवत्यथ। निर्दोषप्रतिभा ह्येनं कृत्स्ना समभिवर्तते॥
en: When the Understanding, which is the soul of the five elements and of the consciousness of Ego, is conquered, the Yogin acquires Omnipotence, and Omniscience.

sa: तस्य नारायणे भक्तिं वहतोऽमित्रकर्षिणः। एकशय्यासनं देवो दत्तवान् देवराट् स्वयम्॥
en: Seeing the devotion to Narayana of that destroyer of foes, the divine king of the gods himself shared with him his own seat and bed.

sa: त्रिः परिक्रान्तवानेतत् सुपर्णो धर्ममुत्तमम्। यस्मात् तस्माद् व्रतं ह्येतत् त्रिसौपर्णमिहोच्यते॥
en: The Rishi Suparna used to recite this excellent religion, three times during the day. Therefore it passed by the name of Trisauparna in the world.

sa: ये तु धर्मे प्रशंसन्तश्चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्। अनाचरन्तस्तद् धर्मे संकरेऽभिरताः प्रभो॥
en: There are persons who wander over the Earth, lauding virtue but without practising what they preach and engaged all the while in sin, O king.

sa: एवमेव कृतप्रज्ञो न दोषैविषयांश्चरन्। असज्जमान: सर्वेषु कथंचन न लिप्यते॥
en: Likewise, a wise man by even enjoying all earthly objects without being attached to any of them, is never affected by shortcomings of any kind.

sa: वाग्यतः प्रणतो भूत्वा ववन्दे परमेश्वरम्। तमुवाच नतं मूर्धा देवानामादिरव्ययः॥
en: The first of all the gods, who is free from decay, said the following words to him whose head was still bent low in veneration.

sa: नारदेन तु सम्प्राप्तः सरहस्य: संसग्रहः। एष धर्मो जगन्नाथात् साक्षान्नारायणानृप॥
en: This religion, with its mysteries and its abstract of details, was won by Narada, O king, from that Lord of the universe, viz., Narayana himself.

sa: प्राग्ज्योतिषं पुरं रम्यं नानाधनसमन्वितम्॥ कुशस्थली नयिष्यामि हत्वा वै दानवोत्तमम्।
en: Killing also another foremost of Danavas, viz., the kill of Pragjyotisha, I shall transplant that delightful city furnished with various kinds of wealth into Dwaraka.

sa: ततः कदाचित् तस्थाय वनस्थस्य समन्ततः। पातयन्निव वृक्षांस्तान् सुमहान् वातसम्भ्रमः॥
en: One day as he was wandering through the forest carrying on his business a great storm took place that shook the trees, almost uprooting them.

sa: अध्यगा नैष्ठिकी बुद्धिं कुतस्त्वामिदमागतम्। एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं निखिलेन महामते॥
en: But how have you gained this stability of understanding? How have you gained this knowledge? O you of great intelligence, tell me all this fully.

sa: ततः प्रदुद्रुवुः सर्वे विप्रसंघाः समन्ततः। गौतमोऽपि सुवर्णस्य भारमादाय सत्वरः॥
en: Then, leaving that place, the Brahmanas, went away in all directions quickly. Gautama also, having taken up a heavy quantity of gold immediately, went away.

sa: सत्कृत्य परिपृष्टः सन् सुमहात्मा महातपाः। निजगाद ततस्तस्मै श्रेयस्करमिदं वचः॥
en: Duly respected by king, and and thus questioned, that great Rishi endued with ascetic merit, then said these words to him which were highly beneficial.

sa: वृकीवोरणमासाद्य मृत्युरादाय गच्छति॥ अद्यैव कुरु यच्छ्रेयो मा त्वां कालोऽत्यगादयम्।
en: Do you, this very day, do what is for your well-being. Let not this death approach. Death drags its victims before their acts are done.

sa: जीवितुं यः स्वयं चेच्छेत् कथं सोऽन्यं प्रघातयेत्। यद् यदात्मनि चेच्छेत तत् परस्यापि चिन्तयेत्॥
en: How can a person who wishes to himself take breath think of preventing another by a murderous act from doing the same? Whatever wishes one cherishes about his own self, one should certainly cherish regarding another.

sa: सा वै तदा मृत्युसंज्ञापदेशा गीता शापाद्बाढमित्यब्रवीत् तम्। अथो प्राणान्प्राणिनामन्तकाले कामक्रोधौ प्राप्य निर्मोह्य हन्ति॥
en: Thus addressed, that lady, Death, became afraid of Brahma's curse and answered him, saying,-Yes! Thence-forward she began to send Desire and Anger at the last hours of living creatures, and through their agency to kill them.

sa: तेषु तेषु हि कालेषु तत्तदङ्गं विशिष्यते। येन यत् सिध्यते कार्यं तत् प्राधान्याय कल्पते॥
en: Some particular ones are regarded as superior to the rest when some important purpose is served through their agency. Superiority, for the time being, is said to belong to that one whose efficacy is thus seen.

sa: निशायाः प्रथमे यामे चोदना द्वादश स्मृताः। मध्ये स्वप्नात् परे यामे द्वादशैव तु चोदनाः॥
en: In the first period of the night, twelve ways of suppressing the vital air are recommended. After sleep, in the last period of the night, other twelve ways of doing the same have been laid down.

sa: विधूय सर्वपापानि देवैः सह वसन्ति ते। भित्त्वा भित्त्वा च कूलानि हत्वा सर्वमिदं जगत्॥
en: A person who raises houses to their foundations and destroys tanks and lakes, indeed, who lays waste the entire universe, does not become stained with sin if he adores and worships the illustrious three eyed god.

sa: नाग उवाच अथ ब्राह्मणरूपेण कं तं समनुपश्यसि। मानुषं केवलं विप्रं देवं वाथ शुचिस्मिते॥
en: The Naga said O you of sweet smiles, for whom have you taken that Brahmana? Is he really a human being or is he some god that has come here in the disguise of a Brahmana?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं कुर्वन् सुखमाप्नोति किं कुर्वन् दुःखमाप्नुयात्। किं कुर्वनिर्भयो लोके सिद्धश्चरति भारत॥
en: By doing what does one gain happiness, and what is that by doing which one meets with misery? What also is that, O Bharata, by doing which one becomes freed from fear and sojourns here successfully,

sa: राजधर्मोवाच भोः कश्यपस्य पुत्रोऽहं माता दाक्षायणी च मे। अतिथिस्त्वं गुणोपेतः स्वागतं ते द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Rajadharman said O Brahmana, I am the son of Kashyapa by one of the daughters of (the sage) Dhaksha. Highly meritorious as you are, you are my guest to-day! You are welcome, O foremost of Brahmana.

sa: रुद्रं दृष्ट्वा बलोद्भूतं प्रमुमोह चचाल च। चित्रं शीघ्रपदत्वाच्च चरन्तमसिपाणिनम्॥ तमेकमसुराः सर्वे सहस्रमिति मेनिरे।
en: Although Rudra was alone and singlehanded, yet so quickly did he move about on the field of battle with the sword in his hand that the Asuras thought there were a thousand Rudras fighting with them.

sa: स आदिः स मध्यः स चान्तः प्रजानां स धाता स धेयं स कर्ता स कार्यम्। युगान्ते प्रसुप्तः सुसंक्षिप्य लोकान् युगादौ प्रबुद्धो जगद्व्युत्ससर्ज॥
en: He is the beginning, He is the middle, and He is the end of all created Beings. He is their Creator and He is the actor and He is the act. Having withdrawn the universe into Himself at the end of the cycle, He enters into sleep, and awakening at the beginning of another cycle, He once more creates the universe.

sa: अत्र ते संशयो मा भूज्ज्ञानं सांख्यं परं मतम्। अक्षरं ध्रुवमेवोक्तं पूर्ण ब्रह्म सनातनम्॥
en: Do not give way to any sort of doubt. The Knowledge which is described in the system of the Sankhyas is considered all the highest. That knowledge is immutable and is eternal. It is eternal Brahma.

sa: स महायोगिनो बुद्ध्वा तं रोषं वै महात्मनः। गतिमागमनं वेत्ति स्थानं चैव ततः प्रभुः॥
